title: Linear independence, basis, and the invariance of dimension
objectives: Test lists of vectors for independence and spanning
Prove that all bases of a finite-dimensional space have the same size
Extend independent sets and prove the dimension formula for sums
Compute coordinates relative to an ordered basis
prerequisites: Chapters 2 and 3: homogeneous systems, subspaces and spans.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 6 and 7 were read in full; the running vectors, the corrected form of the finiteness argument and the exercises are original.
